meta.description: Calculates statistical power for high-dimensional genomics experiments (bulk RNA-seq, scRNA-seq, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, methylation, proteomics) under negative-binomial count models using RNASeqPower, PROPER, and simulation via powsimR, distinguishing per-gene from marginal (transcriptome-wide) power, the role of mean expression and dispersion, and the sequencing-depth-versus-replicate tradeoff.
meta.audit_type: re-audit of fixed Skill (fork branch fix/ed-power)

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI/PMID/sample size/p-value/efficacy figure found in the fixed Skill or any of the 9 outputs. The new Depth Units section's citation to RNASeqPower's own vignette title ('Sample Size for RNA-Seq and similar Studies') was independently checked against the installed package's vignette and is accurate.

practice_boundaries.detail: Unchanged from pre-fix: nothing diagnoses, prescribes or triages an individual; regulated clinical-trial power is still explicitly handed off to clinical-biostatistics/power-and-sample-size in both frontmatter and Decision Tree.

methodological_ground.detail: All three fixed routes are methodologically sound, independently re-derived in this audit: (1) scRNA-seq pseudobulk-on-donors is the statistically correct substitute for the population-DE question and was confirmed to reproduce the donors-not-cells claim by simulation; (2) the proteomics Bonferroni correction is applied correctly and its 3.5-3.6x understatement factor is stable across effect sizes (independently verified at d=0.5/0.8/1.2/2.0, not just the Skill's own d=1.2 example); (3) the Depth Units conversion is correctly derived from RNASeqPower's own vignette and reproduces the Skill's exact worked numbers (0.29 vs 0.82 power).

code_usability.detail: Every code block the fixed Skill ships was executed in this audit and ran without error on the declared package versions (RNASeqPower 1.46.0, PROPER 1.38.0, edgeR 4.4.2, pwr 1.3.0): the bulk RNA-seq closed-form and PROPER simulation blocks, the new Depth Units worked example, the new ATAC/ChIP/methylation rnapower() block, the new proteomics multiplicity block, and the new examples/scrna_pseudobulk_power.R script run verbatim end-to-end. This is a full reversal from the pre-fix state, where three of five assay routes had no code to execute at all.

functional_suitability.note: All five assay routes now have runnable code (up from 2/5 pre-fix). One point withheld: the scRNA-seq route substitutes pseudobulk-on-donors (edgeR) for the originally-named powsimR, which is well-justified (GitHub-only, heavy, not required for the population-power question) and independently confirmed correct, but means powsimR itself remains undemonstrated.

reliability.note: The pre-fix gap (no guidance when computed n is not fundable) is now closed: a Failure Mode row and Common Errors row both instruct reporting achieved power at an affordable n or solving for minimum detectable effect instead.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md grew from ~180 to 262 lines to carry three new sections (scRNA-seq, ATAC/ChIP/methylation, Proteomics) plus Depth Units, but the redundancy-pass commit (d657e59) is a pure 17-line deletion from usage-guide.md with zero lines added to SKILL.md -- confirmed by inspecting that commit's diff in isolation. Net effect: real new content, not duplication; usage-guide.md now holds only Overview/Prerequisites/Quick Start/Example Prompts/Related Skills.

agent_usability.note: Both pre-fix deductions are resolved: 'depth' now has an explicit, cited units conversion with a worked example, and the reviewer-pushback table's promised 'power curve provided' is now backed by an actual plotPower(powr) call in the simulation block (confirmed to run).

human_usability.note: The only pre-fix deduction (depth undefined) is resolved by the new Depth Units section, which gives a concrete formula (depth ~= 0.1 x millions of mapped reads) and a worked conversion.

security.note: Unchanged from pre-fix: no credentials, no eval/exec of user strings, no network calls; still no documented parameter-range validation (e.g. alpha/power outside (0,1)) across any of the now five rnapower()/pwr.t.test call sites.

maintainability.note: Clean per-assay sectioning maintained even after three new sections were added; the redundancy pass further improved this by removing duplicate prose between SKILL.md and usage-guide.md ('state each fact once').

agent_specific.note: The pre-fix P2 (undocumented PROPER seed default) is resolved: Version Compatibility now states sim.seed=11111 explicitly and how to override it, and repeated PROPER runs in this audit reproduced the prior audit's numbers exactly (Actual FDR 0.37/0.18/0.10/0.06, Marginal power 0.24/0.38/0.50/0.60 at Nreps 3/5/8/12). One point withheld: determinism still rests on the underlying package's default rather than an explicit set.seed() the Skill itself calls.

key_strengths: All three pre-fix P1s are resolved and independently re-derived in this audit, not just re-read: scRNA-seq pseudobulk (shipped, executable, reproduces the donors-not-cells claim), proteomics multiplicity (reproduces the Skill's exact n=12/n=43 numbers and generalizes across four effect sizes), and the Depth Units conversion (reproduces the Skill's exact 0.29-vs-0.82 worked example and is cross-checked against a from-scratch NB simulation).

The previously undemonstrated ATAC/ChIP/methylation route now has a runnable rnapower() example whose closed-form output (0.2198) closely matches an independent from-scratch NB simulation (0.23) at the same parameters -- a genuine cross-check, not just a syntax check.

The redundancy pass is exactly what the fix log claims: a pure 17-line deletion from usage-guide.md that added nothing to SKILL.md, and every deleted fact was independently traced to an equivalent home in SKILL.md.

Determinism is now explicit and was independently re-confirmed: the PROPER simulation block, run in this audit, reproduced the pre-fix audit's Actual FDR / Marginal power table to the printed decimal, via the now-documented sim.seed=11111 default.
The unflagged reviewer-pushback contradiction (a power curve promised but never produced) is fixed and was confirmed runnable (plotPower(powr)).

recommendations.title: No documented parameter-range validation across any closed-form call
recommendations.problem: None of the five rnapower()/pwr.t.test call sites (bulk RNA-seq, Depth Units, ATAC/ChIP, proteomics raw, proteomics corrected) documents what happens for out-of-range inputs (e.g. power > 1, negative effect, alpha outside (0,1)).
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill trusts the underlying package's own input handling rather than adding a validation note.
recommendations.fix: Add one line to Version Compatibility noting that alpha/power must be in (0,1) and effect > 1 (or < 1 for depletion), and that the underlying packages do not always error clearly on violations.

recommendations.title: scRNA-seq route's originally-named tool (powsimR) remains unverified
recommendations.problem: The shipped pseudobulk substitute is methodologically sound and independently confirmed, but powsimR itself -- still named as an optional alternative -- has never been run or verified in any audit of this Skill.
recommendations.root_cause: powsimR is GitHub-only with a compile-required dependency and was judged not worth installing given the pseudobulk substitute answers the same question.
recommendations.fix: No action required for deployment; if powsimR is ever pinned and installed in a future audit environment, verify its estimateParam/simulateDE signatures against the version drift already flagged in Version Compatibility.
